metadata.title: Different Windows
metadata.tokenization: One sung syllable per note; leading/trailing hyphens join syllables into a word.

phrases.text: Coffee ring on a moving box
Seven-thirty on the station clock
I kept your note in my jacket seam
A little far isn't out of reach
Every red light tells me wait
Every green light says to go
Different windows, same sky
You turn your lamp on, so do I
If the miles keep pulling through
They can't move the moon from you
New street names in a stranger's rain
I learn the corners, miss my train
Your voice arrives in a midnight tone
Makes this borrowed room feel close to home
Every wrong turn draws a line
Back to where your map meets mine
Different windows, same sky
You turn your lamp on, so do I
If the miles keep pulling through
They can't move the moon from you
Someday the boxes turn to shelves
We stop explaining where we are
No more counting time in calls
No more waving through the dark
Different windows, same sky
You turn your lamp on, so do I
When the morning opens blue
I will share the room with you
Different windows, one light
Leave it burning through the night
Different windows, same sky
